title: Nicolo Bartolini, Milanese agent in Hungary, to Maffeo da Treviglio and the Sforza: letters flagged as cipher

title: Beltrame Costabili despatches in the MNL DF set tagged cipher, beyond the six of catalogue 361
correspondents: Beltrame Costabili to Eleonora d'Aragona / Ercole I d'Este
folio_note: about 25 records; texts mention "zifara" ("Per una mia in zifara de XV", "Dopo laltra mia zifara")
status: Catalogue 361 holds six cipher despatches of 17 Mar 1491 - 20 Mar 1492 (DECODE); 1493 letters were shown clear (costabili1493). The DF set holds many more 1489-92 despatches tagged titkosírás, several citing earlier letters "in zifara". Which of them carry cipher themselves is not determined. known.py: no hit for these DF numbers.
why: Costabili wrote from Esztergom through the 1490-92 succession crisis; extra cipher letters would extend catalogue 361.
